title: Interested in quant?
Join us
hero.sub: We welcome students from all backgrounds. Exec and QRG applications open each semester, but feel free to reach out anytime.

title: The club, or the
research group
paths.sub: The club hosts events and is open to everyone. The research group is for those who want to constantly take on new projects.

cards.label: The club
cards.title: Open for all students
cards.body: Events, workshops and a network of like-minded people. No prerequisites. Any education level is fine as long as you're eager to learn.

cards.label: QRG
cards.title: Quantitative Research Group
cards.body: Research Leads manage paper portfolios; Analysts follow a guided curriculum on systematic trading and help with the research.

title: Three steps, no forms
items: Send us a message on Discord and we'll get you sorted out.
Come to a Tuesday meeting after work hours and introduce yourself.
Exec and QRG applications open every semester for members who want more.

title: Find us here
contact.sub: Questions about events, sponsorship or anything else? Any channel works.
